component.name: GooSlicer
component.summary: Slicer and printer control for ELEGOO Saturn 4 resin printers

description.p: GooSlicer prepares models for ELEGOO Saturn 4, Saturn 4 Ultra and Saturn 4 Ultra 16K MSLA printers: import, orient and arrange, hollow and drill drain holes, add supports, slice to .goo, and send and monitor prints over the local network.
